verdict.rationale: Bento documents transactional email as one of its three email types, alongside broadcasts and sequences, for receipts, login codes, password resets and account notices. Its CLI explicitly can "send transactional emails," and the platform pitches campaigns and transactional email "in one place." However, the evidence never shows a documented API endpoint for one-to-one transactional sends, so the API-delivery part of the story is only implied by the CLI, SDKs and general API docs. missing for 10: a documented transactional-send API endpoint or SDK method, explicit magic-link use-case evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional sending via the API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends

citations.quote: Transactional email is for messages a person needs because of an action, request, or account state: password resets, receipts, login codes, account notices, and order confirmations.
Bento handles three types: broadcasts for one-time campaigns, sequences for automated series, and transactional emails for individual notifications.
create broadcasts and sequences, send transactional emails, manage templates, and more.
Campaigns, automations, and transactional email in one place.
